tone: Speak to her as a knowledgeable industry insider and peer—respectful of her sector expertise and aggressive growth mandate, while still professionally firm about portfolio risk mechanics.
entry_point: Start with a general portfolio review and the current USD 4.2m credit line utilization before moving into concentration risk from the note-linked single-name exposure.
avoid: Don't lead with a direct challenge to her market judgment or reassert that her single-name exposure is too high, since she has already dismissed this framing and it risks putting her on the defensive.
